chat.heading: Chat with Nora
chat.dek: Talk to her right here, without switching to Signal or Discord.
chat.comingSoon: Not wired up yet — she only replies over Signal and Discord for now.

login.heading: Sign in
login.dek: Her status, memory, game servers, and where everyone is — for the group, nobody else.
login.denied: That Discord account isn't on the list. Ask Miles to add it.

status.heading: Status
status.dek: What's running, what's reachable, what she's still holding.
status.storeOk: Working normally — she's writing everything down.
status.storeDown: Having trouble with her message record — she might miss things today.
status.memoryDown: Can't reach her memory right now — she might not remember today.
status.capabilitiesDek: Real capabilities, not all wired up to the portal yet.

roomVocabulary.title: Room's own words
roomVocabulary.description: The slang and in-jokes she's picked up from the group, weighted by how often and how many people use them.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: Live HKO conditions, the same read she gives when you ask her directly.

transit.title: Transit
transit.description: Next bus or train from a saved place, on demand.

doctrine.title: Her doctrine
doctrine.description: A plain-language read of how she's currently tuned to behave — and how that's changed over time.

mediaGallery.title: Media gallery
mediaGallery.description: Stickers, images and clips shared in the room, with her own read on what's in them.

memory.heading: What Nora remembers
memory.dek: Her read on the group — shared across everyone on the list.
memory.roomVocabularyDek: A live word cloud of the group's own slang and in-jokes — coming once this has its own endpoint.

games.heading: Games
games.dek: What's running on the squad's game boxes right now.

map.heading: Where everyone is
map.dek: Tap someone to see their last 24 hours as a route. Positions round to the nearest 10m so a stationary phone doesn't drift on the map.
